dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Who in the world approved that cannon in the town square? Everyone knows kuuvahki messes with people something fierce. And with kids playing nearby, this just feels like bad news waiting to happen..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Last time I stood around it for half an hour, my head started spinning. There must be something wrong with the cannon! For everyone's safety, we have to dismantle it!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Excuse you! If we get rid of the cannon, what's going to happen when the Wild Hunt attacks? Are we going to just sit on our hands and take the entire calamity on the chin?"

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notice
dialogues.text: Although the "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon" requires kuuvahki to operate, it has minimal effect on humans, unlike the energies scattered around the wilderness. Please do not panic.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Look! They admitted it HAS an effect on humans! The proof is in the pudding, everyone!"
